name: MAMO presale mints the referral bonus to the AMM pair
summary: The MAMO presale's BuyToken(referrer) mints the bought MAMO to the buyer and a 10% bonus to any caller-chosen referrer through MAMO.giveawayOne, without excluding the MAMO/USDT pair. With 19 flash-loaned BNB the attacker bought 95M MAMO naming the pair as referrer, so 9.5M MAMO was minted straight into the pair unsynced, then called pair.swap to take that balance as input and withdrew the pair's 5,683 USDT.
notes: The presale is unverified; the mechanism is read from the anchor's trace (two giveawayOne calls, to the buyer and to the pair). Reset is setAddr(2, MAMO), which pointed the presale at the token 43 blocks after MAMO.lp(presale, 1) granted it minting (eip155:56:0x280fbf7226dcc93a3cd859a0518f6594d4fe6807c2a9ba05f8fbea6598d8310d); the later setNum(3, 5,000,000) only raised the sale rate from 500,000 to 5,000,000 MAMO per BNB, which scales the bonus per BNB paid (rule 8). No earlier BuyToken call named the pair as referrer; three transactions in the next block bought from the presale but took nothing from the pair. The 19 BNB the attacker paid went to the project wallet 0x2281dcee for 95M MAMO it kept and is not offset (rule 11).
